meta.title: Add Redis caching for LLM calls
meta.body_summary: Add optional Redis caching for LLM calls with configuration via llm_redis_cache_url, LangChain RedisCache integration, and manual instructor caching.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added Redis caching; sam-portia reviewed with focus on cache key serialization and interface abstraction; author iterated and merged after APPROVED.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1497 changed lines across 33 files, this is a medium-to-large PR by absolute volume. Most churn is in uv.lock (487 lines) and test files, but the core production change in portia/model.py and config.py is moderate (~350 lines). It fits a feature-level performance improvement that merged after iterative code review.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer raised multiple concerns: cache key must include **kwargs to avoid collisions; credentials handling in URL; prefer passing BaseCache object instead of URL; use langchain_redis instead of langchain_community; kwargs may not be JSON-serializable; use InMemoryCache and spec=BaseCache in tests.
review_details.performance_claim: Add Redis caching for LLM calls

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding Redis caching required non-trivial integration with LangChain, instructor, and manual caching logic; the Agent generated a working implementation but needed iterative review to align with design abstractions (BaseCache) and edge-case correctness.

detection_detail.code_reading: sam-portia thoroughly reviewed each hunk, suggesting BaseCache abstraction, kwargs inclusion, and proper JSON serialization.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Unit tests verify caching behavior and configuration, but no performance benchmark or profiler evidence is provided.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: The author iterated through multiple commits, addressing each review comment about cache key, interface, and test improvements.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced Redis caching for LLM calls via a new `llm_redis_cache_url` config option, LangChain's RedisCache for LangChain models, and manual caching keyed on schemas/messages/kwargs for instructor calls.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The majority of line changes (487 lines) are in uv.lock, and additional files are included from merging main branch.
change_trajectory: Initial commit implemented instructor caching and config.
Merged main to incorporate latest changes.
Addressed review: switched to BaseCache interface, moved to langchain_redis, included kwargs in cache key, handled JSON serialization edge cases.
Further CR commits refining tests and model.
Approved and merged after all feedback resolved.

review_signals.summary: Cache key should include **kwargs to prevent collisions.
review_signals.action_taken: Author added kwargs to cache_data dictionary.

review_signals.summary: Pass cache object (BaseCache) instead of URL for flexibility.
review_signals.action_taken: Refactored to accept and use BaseCache instances.

review_signals.summary: Use langchain_redis's RedisCache implementation instead of langchain_community's.
kwargs may not be JSON serializable; consider json.dumps with default=str.
review_signals.action_taken: Author accepted suggestion and added fallback serialization.

review_signals.summary: In tests, use InMemoryCache instead of Redis mock.
Use spec=BaseCache in test mock for interface validation.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial caching implementation.
Reviewer sam-portia requested changes via inline comments: include kwargs, use BaseCache, switch lib, JSON safety, test improvements.
Author iterated with multiple force-pushed commits addressing each point.
After all concerns resolved, reviewer approved and PR merged after ~34 hours.
